summary: Behaviour matches the finding, but stubs cap this at inconclusive. With no out_logits spec, main raised ZeroDivisionError (float division by zero) at eval/compare_q.py:185, the kl_div line, at e1d2fa11d657 and at the fix parent d860f8e1e106. At the fix c0a2028fb579 main completed and returned a perplexity value with no KL divergence.
what_ran: repro.py imports unmodified eval/compare_q.py with third-party packages stubbed and calls main on an uncached spec. Evaluation runs the real test_ppl body, with two rows of 16 random token ids from a replaced get_test_data and random logits from a probe forward function.
limits: No real model or dataset was used, so the perplexity value is meaningless and only shows that finalization completes. The stubbed imports are gptqmodel, aqlm, awq, vptq, bitsandbytes, transformers, exllamav2, datasets, matplotlib, adjustText, llama_cpp and gguf. The ledger's secondary point about collect_logits being unset was not observed separately, because the division fails first.
modifications: compare_q.get_test_data replaced with random token ids
Probe entries added to compare_q.load_fns and compare_q.fwd_fns
sys.argv[0] pointed at a temporary directory so the disk cache stays out of the worktree
